name: g74_pass_no_reserve_sitrus
purpose: Baton Pass with no living reserve and a Sitrus speed tie on both sides (decision 0042 section 14): the two reserves of p1 (Espeon, Gholdengo) are the ones Garchomp (p2) knocks out on p1's second position, so that Umbreon (p1, Sitrus Berry, in the first position) is alone and its Baton Pass fails with [still] and no request. Umbreon (p2) holds Sitrus Berry too, at the same speed. Whether the hit loop runs its Updates on this failure is what the draws of that step show (scripts.ts:526 break on false; the Updates at :537 and :574 on true).
